references.text: Israel's arrival at the Desert of Sinai is described in detail, where they camped before the mountain after leaving Rephidim.
Israel's stay at Rephidim is mentioned, where the people quarreled over water before moving on to Sinai.
At Rephidim, Israel fought against Amalek before continuing their journey to the Desert of Sinai.
At Mount Sinai, God prepared to reveal Himself to the people who had camped there.
Moses refers to Israel's stay at Horeb (Sinai), where they received God's commands.
